description: Intel hotspots with a baseline escalation level (editable).

items.name: Eastern Ukraine front line
items.summary: Active front line of the Russia–Ukraine war across Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv regions.

items.name: Gaza Strip
items.summary: Densely populated territory at the centre of the Israel–Hamas war and a humanitarian emergency.

items.name: Sudan — Darfur and Kordofan
items.summary: Main theatre of the war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces.

items.name: Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb
items.summary: Shipping lane where attacks on vessels have diverted global trade around Africa.

items.name: Eastern DR Congo — North Kivu
items.summary: Long-running armed conflict involving the M23 group and dozens of other armed groups.

items.name: Central Sahel
items.summary: Insurgency by armed groups across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, under military governments.

items.name: Myanmar
items.summary: Civil war between the military government and a range of resistance and ethnic armed groups.

items.name: Haiti — Port-au-Prince
items.summary: Armed gangs control much of the capital; a multinational security mission is deployed.

items.name: Taiwan Strait
items.summary: Frequent military activity around Taiwan; a key risk to regional stability and trade.

items.name: Korean Peninsula
items.summary: Heavily militarised border; North Korea continues missile and weapons development.

items.name: Strait of Hormuz and the Gulf
items.summary: Iran–Gulf tensions around a chokepoint for a large share of seaborne oil.

items.name: Kashmir Line of Control
items.summary: Disputed boundary between India and Pakistan with periodic cross-border incidents.

items.name: South China Sea — Spratly Islands
items.summary: Overlapping territorial claims and frequent coast guard confrontations.

items.name: Lebanon–Israel border
items.summary: Border area with recurring exchanges of fire between Israel and Hezbollah.

items.name: Syria
items.summary: Fragmented control after the fall of the previous government; multiple foreign forces present.

items.name: Somalia
items.summary: Insurgency by al-Shabaab and wider instability in the Horn of Africa.

items.name: Baltic Sea and Kaliningrad
items.summary: NATO–Russia contact zone; undersea cable and pipeline incidents have raised alert levels.

items.name: Venezuela–Guyana (Essequibo)
items.summary: Territorial dispute over the oil-rich Essequibo region.
